subproblem.title: L¹ convergence to a constant from uniformly convergent mollifications and an L¹ mollification error bound
subproblem.statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R > 0, c ∈ ℝ, φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) continuous with compact support, u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) Lebesgue integrable on B_{2R}(0), and a_k ∈ ℝ with a_k → 0. Put w_k(x) := ∫_{B_{2R}(0)} u_k(y)·φ(x − y) dy. Assume w_k → c uniformly on closedBall(0, R) and ∫_{B_R(0)} |u_k(x) − w_k(x)| dx ≤ a_k for all sufficiently large k. Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |u_k(x) − c| dx → 0.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R c : ℝ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < R → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 (2 * R))) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k x => ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) (fun _ => c) atTop (closedBall 0 R) → Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)| ≤ a k) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - c|) atTop (𝓝 0)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 6 of the selected proof (conclusion), including the continuity of w_k asserted there ("w_k continuous hence bounded on the bounded ball").
Notation: ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure (volume); B_r := ball (0 : ℝⁿ) r; w_k(x) := ∫_{B_{2R}} u_k(y)·φ(x − y) dy.
1. (Bound for φ.) As φ is continuous with compact support, there is C ∈ ℝ with |φ(z)| ≤ C for every z (Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support).
2. (Continuity of w_k.) Fix k. Apply the continuity theorem for parametric integrals (continuous_of_dominated) to μ := volume restricted to B_{2R}, F(x, y) := u_k(y)·φ(x − y) and bound(y) := |u_k(y)|·C: (a) for each x, y ↦ F(x, y) is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, being the product of u_k (a.e. strongly measurable because it is μ-integrable) and the continuous function y ↦ φ(x − y); (b) |F(x, y)| = |u_k(y)|·|φ(x − y)| ≤ |u_k(y)|·C for all x and y; (c) y ↦ |u_k(y)|·C is μ-integrable because u_k is integrable on B_{2R}; (d) for each y, x ↦ u_k(y)·φ(x − y) is continuous. Hence w_k is continuous on ℝⁿ.
3. (Integrability on B_R.) Being continuous, w_k is integrable on the compact set closedBall(0, R) (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact) and hence on B_R ⊆ closedBall(0, R). Since R > 0, B_R ⊆ B_{2R} (ball_subset_ball, R ≤ 2R), so u_k is integrable on B_R. Constants are integrable on B_R because volume(B_R) < ∞ (measure_ball_lt_top). Therefore A_k(x) := |u_k(x) − w_k(x)| and B_k(x) := |w_k(x) − c| are integrable on B_R.
4. (Triangle inequality.) For every x, |u_k(x) − c| ≤ A_k(x) + B_k(x) (abs_sub_le). Since |u_k − c| ≥ 0 and A_k + B_k is integrable on B_R, integral_mono_of_nonneg and integral_add give ∫_{B_R}|u_k − c| ≤ (∫_{B_R} A_k) + ∫_{B_R} B_k for every k.
5. (Estimate for large k.) Let m := volume(B_R).toReal ≥ 0, fix ε > 0 and put η := ε/(2(m + 1)) > 0. (a) By uniform convergence on closedBall(0, R) (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff), for all sufficiently large k, |w_k(x) − c| < η for every x ∈ closedBall(0, R), in particular for every x ∈ B_R; for such k, ∫_{B_R} B_k ≤ η·m (norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const, using volume(B_R) < ∞ and |B_k(x)| = B_k(x) ≤ η on B_R). (b) Since a_k → 0, for all sufficiently large k, a_k < ε/2. (c) By hypothesis, for all sufficiently large k, ∫_{B_R} A_k ≤ a_k. (d) η·m = ε·m/(2(m + 1)) < ε/2. Hence, for all sufficiently large k (a finite intersection of eventually-true conditions), 0 ≤ ∫_{B_R}|u_k − c| ≤ ∫_{B_R} A_k + ∫_{B_R} B_k ≤ a_k + η·m < ε/2 + ε/2 = ε, the first inequality because the integrand is nonnegative (integral_nonneg).
6. (Conclusion.) As ε > 0 was arbitrary, ∫_{B_R}|u_k − c| → 0 (Metric.tendsto_nhds). ∎

theorem Submission.cbr_ci_pw_l1_squeeze_of_mollified : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R c : ℝ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < R → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 (2 * R))) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k x => ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) (fun _ => c) atTop (closedBall 0 R) → Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)| ≤ a k) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - c|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  intro n R c φ u a hR hφ hφc hint hunif ha hbound
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hφ.bounded_above_of_compact_support hφc
  -- continuity of the mollifications
  have hwcont : ∀ k, Continuous (fun x => ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) := by
    intro k
    refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun y => ‖u k y‖ * C) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) ?_ ?_
    · exact (hint k).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        (hφ.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC _) (norm_nonneg _)
    · exact (hint k).norm.mul_const C
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun y => continuous_const.mul (hφ.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
  have hBR : ball (0 : Euclid n) R ⊆ ball 0 (2 * R) := ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hvol : volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) < ∞ := measure_ball_lt_top
  have hwint : ∀ k, IntegrableOn (fun x => ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) (ball 0 R) :=
    fun k => ((hwcont k).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 R)).mono_set
      ball_subset_closedBall
  have huint : ∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 R) := fun k => (hint k).mono_set hBR
  have hcint : IntegrableOn (fun _ : Euclid n => c) (ball 0 R) := integrableOn_const hvol.ne
  have htri : ∀ k, ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - c| ≤
      (∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)|) +
        ∫ x in ball 0 R, |(∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) - c| := by
    intro k
    have hA : IntegrableOn (fun x => |u k x - ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)|)
        (ball 0 R) := ((huint k).sub (hwint k)).abs
    have hB : IntegrableOn (fun x => |(∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) - c|)
        (ball 0 R) := ((hwint k).sub hcint).abs
    rw [← integral_add hA hB]
    exact integral_mono_of_nonneg (Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_nonneg _) (hA.add hB)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_sub_le _ _ _)
  set m := (volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)).toReal with hm
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  have hη0 : 0 < ε / (2 * (m + 1)) := by positivity
  have h1 := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hunif _ hη0
  have h2 := Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 ha (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [h1, h2, hbound] with k hk1 hk2 hk3
  have hwc : ∫ x in ball 0 R, |(∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) - c| ≤
      ε / (2 * (m + 1)) * m := by
    have := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hvol (C := ε / (2 * (m + 1)))
      (f := fun x => |(∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) - c|) (fun x hx => by
        have := hk1 x (ball_subset_closedBall hx)
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at this
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs, abs_sub_comm]
        exact this.le)
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans ((Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm ▸ this)
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - c| := integral_nonneg fun x => abs_nonneg _
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hk2
  have hak : a k < ε / 2 := (le_abs_self _).trans_lt hk2
  have hlast : ε / (2 * (m + 1)) * m < ε / 2 := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have := htri k
  linarith
proof_key_steps: |φ| ≤ C; dominated continuity of parametric integrals (continuous_of_dominated, bound |u_k|·C) makes every w_k continuous.
w_k (continuous on the compact closedBall(0,R)), u_k (B_R ⊆ B_{2R}) and constants are integrable on B_R, so ∫_{B_R}|u_k − c| ≤ ∫_{B_R}|u_k − w_k| + ∫_{B_R}|w_k − c|.
For ε > 0 and η := ε/(2(m+1)), m = |B_R|: eventually |w_k − c| < η on closedBall(0,R), a_k < ε/2 and ∫_{B_R}|u_k − w_k| ≤ a_k, hence 0 ≤ ∫_{B_R}|u_k − c| ≤ a_k + ηm < ε.

subproblem.title: Densities of weakly convergent density-represented top-dimensional currents converge against scalar test functions
subproblem.statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ = Euclid n an arbitrary set, c ∈ ℝ, Y_k ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ). Write e := (e_0, …, e_{n−1}) with e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Assume (i) Y_k(ω) = ∫_U u_k(y)·ω(y)(e) dy for every k and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n), and (ii) Y_k(ω) → c·∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(y)(e) dy as k → ∞ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then for every b : ℝⁿ → ℝ that is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), has compact support and satisfies tsupport b ⊆ U, ∫_U u_k(y)·b(y) dy → c·∫_{ℝⁿ} b(y) dy as k → ∞.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (c : ℝ) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Y k ω = ∫ y in U, u k y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun k => Y k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))))) → ∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in U, u k y * b y) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, b y))
subproblem.natural_proof:

subproblem.title: Boundary mass bounds the directional-derivative pairings of the density of a top-dimensional current
subproblem.statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, n := d + 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ = Euclid (d + 1) an arbitrary set, Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) and u : ℝⁿ → ℝ with Y(ω) = ∫_U u(y)·ω(y)(e) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U (d + 1)), where e = (e_0, …, e_d), e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Assume M_U(∂Y) = Y.boundary.massOn U ≠ ∞. Let ε ∈ Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d, f : ℝⁿ → ℝ, z ∈ ℝⁿ and M ∈ ℝ satisfy: |ε| ≤ ‖z‖ (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm); d(f·ε)(y)(e) = Df(y)(z) for every y ∈ ℝⁿ (exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y e = fderiv ℝ f y z); f is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), has compact support and tsupport f ⊆ U; and |f(y)| ≤ M for every y. Then |∫_U u(y)·Df(y)(z) dy| ≤ (M_U(∂Y)).toReal·‖z‖·M.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (d + 1))) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (u : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d) (f : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)) (M : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), Y ω = ∫ y in U, u y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → Y.boundary.massOn U ≠ ∞ → covectorEuclideanNorm ε ≤ ‖z‖ → (∀ y, exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ f y z) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → (∀ y, |f y| ≤ M) → |∫ y in U, u y * fderiv ℝ f y z| ≤ (Y.boundary.massOn U).toReal * ‖z‖ * M
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 4 of the selected proof (variation bound), with its η → 0 argument supplied by the sibling eval_mass_bound and the homogeneity |a·α| = |a|·|α| by the sibling norm_props. The covector ε of the selected proof (from the parent's prerequisite interior_form) enters only through the hypotheses |ε| ≤ ‖z‖ and d(f·ε)(y)(e) = Df(y)(z).
Notation: n = d + 1; e := (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) : Fin (d + 1) → ℝⁿ; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; ∂Y := Y.boundary ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U d; M_U(∂Y) := Y.boundary.massOn U.
1. (The test d-form γ.) Put γ(x) := f(x)•ε. It is C^∞ (ContDiff.smul hf contDiff_const), it has compact support (HasCompactSupport.smul_right applied to the compact support of f), and tsupport γ ⊆ tsupport f ⊆ U (tsupport_smul_subset_left). Hence γ belongs to testFormOnSubmodule U d, i.e. γ ∈ TestFormOn U d, and tsupport γ ⊆ U.
2. (M ≥ 0.) 0 ≤ |f(0)| ≤ M.
3. (Coefficient bound.) By the sibling norm_props (Submission.rsd_mw_tfa_norm_props (d + 1) d, part (ii): |t•α| = |t|·|α|), for every x: |γ(x)| = |f(x)•ε| = |f(x)|·|ε| ≤ M·‖z‖, because |f(x)| ≤ M, 0 ≤ |ε| ≤ ‖z‖ (covectorEuclideanNorm_nonneg and the hypothesis) and M ≥ 0 (step 2) (mul_le_mul).
4. (Mass bound.) Apply the sibling eval_mass_bound (Submission.cmr_abs_apply_le_massOn) with P := d + 1, degree d, the domain U, W := U, T := ∂Y, ω := γ and r := M‖z‖. Its hypotheses hold: M_U(∂Y) ≠ ∞ (assumption), tsupport γ ⊆ U (step 1) and |γ(x)| ≤ M‖z‖ for every x (step 3). Hence |∂Y(γ)| ≤ M‖z‖·(M_U(∂Y)).toReal.
5. (Identification of ∂Y(γ).) By the definition of the boundary (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply), ∂Y(γ) = Y(dγ), where dγ := exteriorDerivativeTestOn U d γ ∈ TestFormOn U (d + 1) has underlying form exteriorDerivative γ = exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) (definitionally). By the representation hypothesis, Y(dγ) = ∫_U u(y)·(exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε))(y)(e) dy, and by the hypothesis on ε the integrand equals u(y)·Df(y)(z) at every point y. Since the integrands agree everywhere, ∂Y(γ) = ∫_U u(y)·Df(y)(z) dy (no measurability of U is used).
6. (Conclusion.) By steps 4 and 5, |∫_U u(y)·Df(y)(z) dy| ≤ M‖z‖·(M_U(∂Y)).toReal = (M_U(∂Y)).toReal·‖z‖·M. ∎

theorem Submission.cbr_ci_pw_l1_boundary_variation_bound : ∀ (d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (d + 1))) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (u : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d) (f : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)) (M : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), Y ω = ∫ y in U, u y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → Y.boundary.massOn U ≠ ∞ → covectorEuclideanNorm ε ≤ ‖z‖ → (∀ y, exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ f y z) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → (∀ y, |f y| ≤ M) → |∫ y in U, u y * fderiv ℝ f y z| ≤ (Y.boundary.massOn U).toReal * ‖z‖ * M := by
  intro d U Y u ε f z M hrep hfin hεn hεd hf hfc hfU hM
  have hsmul := (Submission.rsd_mw_tfa_norm_props (d + 1) d).2.1
  have hsupp : tsupport (fun x => f x • ε : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) d) ⊆ U :=
    (tsupport_smul_subset_left f (fun _ => ε)).trans hfU
  have hmem : (fun x => f x • ε : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) d) ∈
      testFormOnSubmodule (E := Euclid (d + 1)) U d :=
    ⟨⟨hf.smul contDiff_const, hfc.smul_right⟩, hsupp⟩
  let γ : TestFormOn U d := ⟨fun x => f x • ε, hmem⟩
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM 0)
  have hbound : ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) d) x) ≤ M * ‖z‖ := by
    intro x
    change covectorEuclideanNorm (f x • ε) ≤ M * ‖z‖
    rw [hsmul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hM x) hεn (covectorEuclideanNorm_nonneg ε) hM0
  have key := Submission.cmr_abs_apply_le_massOn (d + 1) d U U Y.boundary γ (M * ‖z‖) hfin hsupp hbound
  have heq : Y.boundary γ = ∫ y in U, u y * fderiv ℝ f y z := by
    rw [GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply, hrep]
    congr 1
    funext y
    change u y * exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = _
    rw [hεd y]
  rw [heq] at key
  calc |∫ y in U, u y * fderiv ℝ f y z| ≤ M * ‖z‖ * (Y.boundary.massOn U).toReal := key
    _ = (Y.boundary.massOn U).toReal * ‖z‖ * M := by ring
proof_key_steps: γ := f·ε is a test d-form on U with tsupport γ ⊆ tsupport f ⊆ U.
eval_mass_bound with W := U, T := ∂Y, r := M‖z‖: |∂Y(γ)| ≤ M‖z‖·M_U(∂Y).toReal.
∂Y(γ) = Y(dγ) = ∫_U u·d(f·ε)(e) = ∫_U u·Df(z) by the representation and the hypothesis on ε; rearrange the product.
